name: Shinjou Aoi
source:
[url=/c156948]Shinjo[/url]'s other younger sister who works as the manager of a maid cafe in Akihabara.
After [url=/c157629]Ruri[/url]'s disappearance, she often clashed with her brother, who had immersed himself in game development, and they have barely seen each other for the past 13 years. Since graduating high school, she has continued to live in Akihabara, the site of the incident.
While usually somewhat detached, she occasionally reveals a tsundere side that captivates many of her customers.

[From in-game profile]
